data.case_title: Rejected sidewalk permit for construction debris container (Fleetstieg 9)
data.title: Rejection of special-use permit (Sondernutzung) for a construction debris container
data.summary: Bezirksamt Musterwandsbek (Fachamt Management des öffentlichen Raumes) rejected Thore Mustermöller's application to place a 7 m³ construction debris container on the sidewalk in front of Fleetstieg 9, Hamburg, from 3 to 28 May 2027, because the resulting walkway would be less than 1.00 m wide, which is not acceptable under the Hamburg Ways Act (Hamburgisches Wegegesetz).
data.explanation: The district office has refused permission to put a building-waste container on the public sidewalk, saying it would leave too little space for pedestrians and wheelchairs. It suggests checking whether the container can instead be placed on the private property. If you disagree with the refusal, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the same office; the app will show the deadline for this, calculated from when the letter is deemed delivered. If you take no action, the refusal stands and the permit will not be granted.
